summary: Iteration-11 — tested the new admin ability to delete users / vendors (and the existing listing-delete regression). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_admin_delete.py — 7 pass, 1 skipped (cross-admin delete block skipped because only one admin is seeded, the self-delete 400 covers the same code path). Verified: DELETE /api/admin/users/{uid} returns 401/403 for unauthenticated + non-admin, 404 for unknown id, 400 for self, 400 for another admin (would be covered if a 2nd admin existed), 200 for a buyer with deposit+ticket cascading cleanup (deposits/tickets/notifications/audit_logs with user_id removed; counts {products,keys,orders,deposits,withdrawals,tickets} returned; audit 'user.delete' entry written; user cannot log in). Vendor deletion also wipes products + license_keys + their listings disappear from public /api/products. Product-delete regression (DELETE /api/admin/products/{pid}) correctly removed the product + 2 unsold keys while 1 sold key and the buyer's order stayed intact. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x4000, admin@market.com/Admin@123 via math captcha): Admin > Users — user-delete-{id} trash button is rendered for the throwaway buyer and NOT for the admin row; opens user-delete-dialog; because the buyer was credited $25, user-delete-balance-warning is visible inside the dialog; user-delete-cancel closes it; user-delete-confirm deletes the row (admin-user-row-{id} disappears). Admin > Vendors (approved filter) — vendor-delete-{id} opens the SAME user-delete-dialog and user-delete-confirm removes admin-vendor-row-{id}. Admin > Listings regression — listing-delete-{id} -> listing-delete-dialog -> listing-delete-confirm deletes a pending listing (toast 'Listing deleted' visible, row removed).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_delete_user (server.py:1399) performs 7 separate delete_many calls with no transaction. On partial failure (e.g. mongo blip after products are gone but before orders) the user doc stays but their products/keys are already wiped — orphans possible. Consider wrapping in a session.start_transaction() or at least deleting the users doc FIRST so a mid-run error leaves data under a now-missing user id but doesn't leave a 'ghost' user whose cascade half-ran.

The license_keys cascade filter uses {"$or": [{"vendor_id": uid}, {"product_id": {"$in": pids}}]} — but `pids` was captured via to_list(100000), so a vendor with >100k products silently drops keys for the overflow. Rare, but a projection cursor with no limit (or deleting keys first by vendor_id only — assuming every key has vendor_id — would be safer).

The admin block check `if u['role'] == 'admin': 400 'Admin accounts cannot be deleted'` is broader than the spec (spec says 'deleting ANOTHER admin'). Since self-delete is already blocked earlier with its own 400, this effectively prevents deleting ANY admin — fine, but the error string is identical for self vs another admin, making UI messaging slightly misleading.

DeleteUserDialog (AdminUsers.jsx:90) computes `owed = balance_cents + (role==='vendor' ? earnings_cents : 0)` and shows the warning only when owed > 0. If a vendor has balance=0 but earnings=0 the warning is skipped — fine. BUT the warning text claims 'wallet balance ... will be lost'. For a vendor with earnings>0 only (balance=0), the sentence still reads '$0.00 wallet balance and $X earnings' — technically correct but reads oddly. Consider conditionally omitting the $0 clause.

AdminVendors reuses DeleteUserDialog from AdminUsers but passes the whole vendor row — the dialog title falls back to `store_name || name` which is good; the description still says 'orders, deposits, tickets' even for a vendor. Since vendors can also hold wallet balance / open tickets this is accurate.

No concurrency protection: an admin could click user-delete-confirm twice; the first call deletes, the second returns 404 via the dialog's throw — the ConfirmDialog surfaces errMsg to toast which is acceptable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 run, 1 skipped due to seed limitation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (user delete button gating, dialog open/warning/cancel/confirm, vendor delete via same dialog, listing-delete regression — all pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DELETE /api/admin/users/{uid} is implemented in server.py:1399. Returns {ok, products, keys, orders, deposits, withdrawals, tickets}. Blocks: self (400 'Cannot delete your own account'), admin role (400 'Admin accounts cannot be deleted'), unknown (404 'User not found'). Cascade wipes products (vendor_id), license_keys ($or vendor_id/product_id∈pids), orders ($or buyer_id/vendor_id), deposits (user_id), withdrawals (vendor_id), tickets (user_id), notifications (user_id), audit_logs (user_id). Audit log 'user.delete' is appended by actor admin. Deposits that stay in status='awaiting_txid' only show in /admin/deposits?status=all. Frontend: AdminUsers DeleteUserDialog is REUSED by AdminVendors (import { DeleteUserDialog } from './AdminUsers'). Testids: user-delete-{uid}, vendor-delete-{uid}, user-delete-dialog, user-delete-balance-warning (only when balance+earnings>0), user-delete-cancel, user-delete-confirm. Admin row has NO user-delete button (gated by u.role !== 'admin'). Listings keep listing-delete-{pid} -> listing-delete-dialog -> listing-delete-confirm.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. Both backend cascade and frontend dialog gating work exactly to spec. Minor code-review suggestions above (transaction safety, 100k projection cap, warning copy) are non-blocking.
